cover_letter:
Dear Willian,

I'm writing to apply for the Growth Analyst position at Kayzen. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I've been following Kayzen's AI-native approach to programmatic advertising, and I'm excited about the opportunity to bring my analytical mindset and automation skills to your Trading team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track and optimize performance. I also manage CMS content and have built and maintained WordPress sites, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major retailers and ran SEO analyses. My front-end development experience at ViviDoctor gave me a solid understanding of web technologies and data flows.

What draws me to this role is the hands-on trading focus combined with advanced analytics and LLM-powered workflows. I already use Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content, and audits, and I've built Python automations and MCP integrations to streamline repetitive tasks. I'm comfortable with data and eager to deepen my SQL skills, learn about MMPs and attribution, and contribute to campaign optimization. I'm curious about automation and believe LLMs can transform how teams analyze and act on data.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, close to CET, and I'm excited about the remote setup and the opportunity to work with a multinational team. I'm solution-oriented, clear in communication, and always ready to ask questions and collaborate.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Kayzen's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
